description: Interactive trigger elements. Emphasis level determines variant selection.

sizing.paddingHorizontal: 25px (btn-px — spec exception, not on the 4px spacing scale)
sizing.paddingVertical: 7px  (btn-py — spec exception, not on the 4px spacing scale)
sizing.borderRadius: 50vh (pill shape — use 50vh not a fixed px value to prevent distortion on word wraps)

mobile.note: Buttons expand to fill 80% of screen width on mobile

variants.name: solid-primary
variants.description: Primary action button. Use for the single most important action per view.

do: One primary button per section max
dont: Do not use more than one primary button per section
Do not place on similarly colored backgrounds

variants.name: solid-secondary
variants.description: Secondary solid button. Supports primary actions with slightly lower hierarchy.

do: Pair with primary button for an alternative action
dont: Do not use in isolation as the only CTA

variants.name: solid-tertiary
variants.description: Tertiary solid button using black fill. Third-level solid action.

do: Use to create hierarchy when primary and secondary are already present
dont: Do not use as primary CTA
Do not mix with transparent buttons in same action group

variants.name: outlined
variants.description: Stroke-only button for medium emphasis. Secondary user actions.

do: Pair with solid button as secondary action
dont: Do not use as primary CTA
Do not use on backgrounds that obscure the border

variants.name: transparent
variants.description: No fill, no border. Lowest emphasis. ONLY valid on dark backgrounds.

do: Pair as supplemental action alongside high/medium emphasis buttons
dont: Do not use on light or white backgrounds
Do not use as sole action — always accompany with a higher emphasis button

states.hover: Visual feedback when cursor is over the button
states.focused: Keyboard focus — outline ring offset in variant primary color (white for transparent)

iconGap.note: Gap between icon and label — snapped from 6px per spacing audit

groupGap.note: Gap between two buttons in an action group

do: Match button emphasis to action importance
Use Roboto Bold for all button labels
Use 50vh border-radius to preserve pill shape
Use variant primary color token for focus ring
Use white focus ring on transparent buttons only
dont: Do not mix more than two button variants in a single action group
Do not use transparent buttons on light backgrounds — dark backgrounds only
Do not override border-radius with a fixed pixel value — use 50vh
Do not use 6px icon gap — snap to 4px (sp-1) per spacing audit
